note: The single source of the eval thresholds (G6 §6.0, C250 Release B). src/evals.ts reads the cycle block; eval/run.ts reads both. A cycle metric below its minSample answers pass null (not enough data).

baseline.note: Thresholds = the measured baseline of the 0.2.13 detector on eval/cases/detector (G6 floors: precision 0.9, recall 0.8). Besides these, eval/run.ts fails on ANY case mismatch. Cases with knownMiss: true (near-duplicates: word order, plural, typo) carry the gold group as expected; they are E5 targets, reported as known misses and kept out of precision and recall.
